prompt: A complete visual redesign is a score in design-score.json, not a filled proposal list. This inventory is for a single variable that must differ from that score. You are aligning the Custom UI kit with an internal design system. This JSON is the complete override contract. Fill proposal only. Do not add, rename, or remove tokens. proposal stays null when the kit default should remain. When themes is an object, proposal must be { "light": "<css>", "dark": "<css>" }. When themes is null, proposal must be a single CSS value string. Set variables on an ancestor such as .ui-config. Components read var(--name, fallback) and do not redeclare the public name, so the ancestor wins. fallback and fallbackByVariant are the kit defaults used when the variable is unset. Do not copy them into proposal unless the design intentionally matches them. One --ui-button-* value applies to every button variant. Variant differences exist only while the variable is unset. Pagination radius is fixed at 2px and is not a token. Do not invent a token for it. prefers-reduced-motion sets --ui-press-scale to 1 and collapses transition duration. Do not encode meaning in motion. Return the same JSON with proposal filled, then one CSS block for .ui-config and [data-theme="dark"] .ui-config containing only variables whose proposal is not null.
rules: Override on an ancestor. Never redeclare --ui-* on the component itself.
Foundation tokens change every consumer. Component hooks change one family.
A hook left unset keeps fallback or fallbackByVariant.
Theme tokens require both light and dark.
Do not invent token names. Pagination, dialog chrome, the radio dot, and the checkbox mark are documented under fixed because they are not hooks.

tree.title: Foundation
tree.summary: Declared on :root. Changing one of these moves every component that falls back to it. Theme colors and shadows have light and dark values. Type, space, radii, motion, and layout metrics are shared.

children.title: Color
children.summary: Light and dark. Accent is the only chromatic emphasis. Status colors are for alerts and badges.

children.title: Type
children.summary: Segoe UI Variable for text and display. Cascadia Mono for code.

children.title: Space
children.summary: Seven steps from 0.25rem to 3rem. Used as gap and padding.

children.title: Shape
children.summary: Chrome radii are 2px, 4px, and 6px. Full is the pill radius. Buttons do not use this scale.

children.title: Scrollbar
children.summary: The page bar and every scrollable region. Size and radius are declared. Track and thumb are hooks, so an ancestor can restyle them without touching the kit.
fixed: Firefox uses scrollbar-width thin. The size token sets the WebKit thickness.
The carousel track hides its scrollbar. Paging is the control.

children.title: Motion
children.summary: Color in 120ms, press in 90ms, reveal in 180ms. prefers-reduced-motion sets --ui-press-scale to 1 and collapses duration.

children.title: Elevation
children.summary: Small and medium shadows are none. Only the pop shadow is visible, on dialogs and select menus.

children.title: Layout
children.summary: Content and sidebar widths are declared. Container width and grid min are hooks with fallbacks.

tree.title: Button
tree.summary: Hooks are unset, so each variant keeps its own fallback until an ancestor sets the variable. One set value applies to primary, secondary, ghost, and danger together.
fixed: Disabled is opacity 0.4. There is no disabled color token.
Pressed scale reads --ui-press-scale. Text fields do not scale.
Focus ring is a 2px outline of --ui-color-focus.
Pagination does not read --ui-button-radius.

children.title: Shared
children.summary: Radius is the only button token declared by the kit. Default is 0.75rem.

children.title: Rest
children.summary: Transparent fill. Primary border is an 18% foreground hairline. Ghost has no border. Danger text is --ui-color-danger.

children.title: Hover
children.summary: Primary hover is an accent wash at 14%, not an inverted solid. Secondary and ghost use --ui-color-subtle. Danger uses --ui-color-danger-subtle.

tree.title: Field
tree.summary: Input, textarea, and the select button share --ui-control-*. Set the hook to restyle fields without recoloring the whole page.
fixed: Placeholder color is --ui-color-muted and has no separate hook.
Invalid label color is --ui-color-danger.
Focus ring stays --ui-color-focus even when --ui-control-border-focus changes.
Text fields do not use --ui-press-scale, so the caret does not jump.

children.title: Chrome
children.summary: Rest, hover, focus, invalid, and disabled. Each border state has its own hook.

children.title: Size
children.summary: Declared heights for sm, md, and lg.

tree.title: Choice
tree.summary: Checkbox fill and the radio ring are hooks. The radio dot, the checkbox mark, and the off switch are foundation colors.
fixed: Checkbox mark uses --ui-color-accent-fg.
Unchecked checkbox uses --ui-color-border-strong and --ui-color-surface, with --ui-radius-sm.
Radio inner dot uses --ui-color-accent. Only the selected ring reads --ui-choice-border-checked.
Off switch track uses --ui-color-border-strong. Thumb uses --ui-color-surface.

children.title: Checked
children.summary: Checkbox fill and the shared checked border. Radio uses the border hook only.

children.title: Switch
children.summary: On-track hook. Falls back to the accent.

tree.title: Table
tree.summary: Frame, scroll cap, hover, and selection are hooks. A form inside a cell uses as="region" so it does not nest a form element.
fixed: Embedded tables ignore --ui-table-max-height.
Hover is suppressed on the selected row and on a row that contains focus.
Zebra rows use --ui-color-subtle.

children.title: Frame
children.summary: Background, border, radius, and max height.

children.title: Row
children.summary: Hover falls back to surface-raised. Selection falls back to accent-subtle.

tree.title: Dialog
tree.summary: No dedicated dialog color hooks. The panel reads foundation tokens.
fixed: Panel fill is --ui-color-surface. Border is --ui-color-border. Radius is --ui-radius-lg. Shadow is --ui-shadow-pop.
Backdrop is --ui-color-overlay.
Entrance uses --ui-duration-reveal.
Native showModal stacks on the top layer. Close order is still top dialog first.

tree.title: Pagination
fixed: Each page is 1.75rem square with a 2px radius. It does not read --ui-button-radius.
Idle text is --ui-color-muted. Idle border is --ui-color-border.
Current page fill is --ui-color-fg and its text is --ui-color-bg.
Focus ring is --ui-color-focus. Press scale is --ui-press-scale.

tree.title: Slider
tree.summary: Track, fill, and thumb. Each falls back to a foundation color.
fixed: The thumb border uses the fill color.

tree.title: Progress
tree.summary: Track and fill. Both fall back to foundation colors.

tree.title: Date
tree.summary: The selected day. Unset, it uses the accent and the accent foreground.

tokens.name: --ui-color-bg
tokens.affects: Page background behind the app shell and gallery.

tokens.name: --ui-color-fg
tokens.affects: Primary text. Also the filled current page in pagination.

tokens.name: --ui-color-muted
tokens.affects: Secondary text, placeholders, idle pagination numbers, ghost button text.

tokens.name: --ui-color-subtle
tokens.affects: Quiet fills: secondary and ghost hover, disabled field background, zebra rows.

tokens.name: --ui-color-surface
tokens.affects: Field, table, dialog, checkbox, and switch-thumb surfaces.

tokens.name: --ui-color-surface-raised
tokens.affects: Table row hover when --ui-table-row-hover is unset.

tokens.name: --ui-color-border
tokens.affects: Hairline on fields, tables, pagination, and the dialog panel.

tokens.name: --ui-color-border-strong
tokens.affects: Hover border, unchecked checkbox, and the off switch track.

tokens.name: --ui-color-ink
tokens.affects: Reserved ink paired with --ui-color-paper. Not the default body text.

tokens.name: --ui-color-paper
tokens.affects: Reserved paper paired with --ui-color-ink.

tokens.name: --ui-color-accent
tokens.affects: The only accent. Focus, checked choice, switch, and primary hover border fall back here.

tokens.name: --ui-color-accent-hover
tokens.affects: Darker or lighter accent for a hover that needs a solid accent, not a wash.

tokens.name: --ui-color-accent-fg
tokens.affects: Text or icon on a solid accent, including the checkbox mark.

tokens.name: --ui-color-accent-subtle
tokens.affects: Selected table row and the active select option.

tokens.name: --ui-color-danger
tokens.affects: Destructive text, invalid borders, and invalid field labels.

tokens.name: --ui-color-danger-hover
tokens.affects: Solid danger hover when a component asks for a darker danger.

tokens.name: --ui-color-danger-fg
tokens.affects: Text on a solid danger fill.

tokens.name: --ui-color-danger-subtle
tokens.affects: Danger button hover wash and danger alert background.

tokens.name: --ui-color-success
tokens.affects: Success tone for alerts and badges.

tokens.name: --ui-color-success-fg
tokens.affects: Text on a solid success fill.

tokens.name: --ui-color-success-subtle
tokens.affects: Success alert and badge background.

tokens.name: --ui-color-warning
tokens.affects: Warning tone for alerts and badges.

tokens.name: --ui-color-warning-fg
tokens.affects: Text on a warning fill. Dark in both themes.

tokens.name: --ui-color-warning-subtle
tokens.affects: Warning alert and badge background.

tokens.name: --ui-color-info
tokens.affects: Info tone for alerts and badges.

tokens.name: --ui-color-info-fg
tokens.affects: Text on a solid info fill.

tokens.name: --ui-color-info-subtle
tokens.affects: Info alert and badge background.

tokens.name: --ui-color-focus
tokens.affects: Focus ring (outline) on buttons, fields, choices, tabs, and pagination.

tokens.name: --ui-color-overlay
tokens.affects: Dialog backdrop and the mobile sidebar scrim.

tokens.name: --ui-font-sans
tokens.value: 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif
tokens.affects: UI text.

tokens.name: --ui-font-display
tokens.value: 'Segoe UI Variable Display', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif
tokens.affects: Display headings.

tokens.name: --ui-font-mono
tokens.affects: Code and token names.

tokens.name: --ui-font-size-xs
tokens.affects: Labels, hints, and table meta.

tokens.name: --ui-font-size-sm
tokens.affects: Controls, buttons, and body copy in dense UI.

tokens.name: --ui-font-size-md
tokens.affects: Default body size.

tokens.name: --ui-font-size-lg
tokens.affects: Section titles inside panels.

tokens.name: --ui-font-size-xl
tokens.affects: Page titles.

tokens.name: --ui-font-size-2xl
tokens.affects: Hero display size.

tokens.name: --ui-line-height
tokens.affects: Default line height.

tokens.name: --ui-space-1
tokens.affects: Smallest step. Icon gaps and tight padding.

tokens.name: --ui-space-2
tokens.affects: Control internal gap and compact stacks.

tokens.name: --ui-space-3
tokens.affects: Default stack gap between fields.

tokens.name: --ui-space-4
tokens.affects: Section padding and form group gap.

tokens.name: --ui-space-5
tokens.affects: Loose stacks.

tokens.name: --ui-space-6
tokens.affects: Page section separation.

tokens.name: --ui-space-7
tokens.affects: Largest step.

tokens.name: --ui-radius-sm
tokens.affects: Checkbox, menu item, and small chrome.

tokens.name: --ui-radius-md
tokens.affects: Fields and the select list. Control radius falls back here.

tokens.name: --ui-radius-lg
tokens.affects: Table frame and dialog panel.

tokens.name: --ui-radius-full
tokens.affects: Switch track, pills, and filter chips.

tokens.name: --ui-scrollbar-size
tokens.affects: Thickness of every scrollbar in WebKit. Firefox stays on the thin keyword.

tokens.name: --ui-scrollbar-radius
tokens.affects: Thumb corner.

tokens.name: --ui-scrollbar-track
tokens.affects: Track behind the thumb.

tokens.name: --ui-scrollbar-thumb
tokens.affects: Thumb at rest.

tokens.name: --ui-scrollbar-thumb-hover
tokens.affects: Thumb while the pointer is over it. Firefox has no hover state for scrollbar-color.

tokens.name: --ui-duration
tokens.affects: Color, border, and background transitions.

tokens.name: --ui-duration-press
tokens.affects: Press scale on buttons, choices, and pagination.

tokens.name: --ui-duration-reveal

tokens.name: --ui-press-scale
tokens.affects: Scale applied on :active. Reduced motion forces 1.

tokens.name: --ui-ease
tokens.affects: Shared easing. No overshoot.

tokens.name: --ui-shadow-sm
tokens.affects: Reserved small shadow. The kit default is none in both themes.

tokens.name: --ui-shadow-md
tokens.affects: Reserved medium shadow. The kit default is none in both themes.

tokens.name: --ui-shadow-pop

tokens.name: --ui-content-width
tokens.affects: Main column width. Container width falls back here.

tokens.name: --ui-sidebar-width
tokens.affects: Sidebar width.

tokens.name: --ui-container-width
tokens.affects: Optional container cap. Unset, so it follows the content width.

tokens.name: --ui-grid-min
tokens.affects: Minimum track size for the auto-fit grid.

tokens.name: --ui-button-radius
